readback: Require terminal successful planned16CPU128G/bizon execution and the entire ordered four-arm panel, with immutable launch/plan/scientific-source/runtime/input checks. Never admit only selected passing rows from a failed panel.

Preserve ordered checkpoint gene IDs for query/anchor validation. Repeat actual raw selective receipt/profile-source ownership/measurement parsing and decision readback, using exact pinned HMMER3.4 tools and complete competitor/member/target sets. This shares validated algorithm implementations; it is not an independent algorithm implementation or biological confirmation.

Require a single identical candidate-generation digest across all active arms. Off must exactly reproduce canonical candidates/constraints/native products/species tree and scores. Measurement-only must exactly reproduce off graph stage contents, candidate/constraint products, native products/species tree and full aggregate/per-family scoring; it cannot advance as a method.

Repeat actual native pair/confidence turnover counts from raw native files, separately from reference OG accuracy, and preserve command/log/timing/input/output provenance. Resource allocations are not measured memory peaks; shared-host cached replay is not isolated fresh pipeline timing.

Recompute each active reselect arm's original independent off-relative point gate. A completely unmeasured arm cannot advance; preserve its applicability/fallback requirement. Zero actual changed decisions remains explicit rather than a manufactured activation claim.

uncertainty.contrasts: Three off-relative arm contrasts, including the exact measurement identity check, plus HMMER reselect versus builtin reselect; three metrics each. Use the same conservative12-endpoint Bonferroni tails for all reported intervals.
uncertainty.method: Existing paired-family bootstrap of weighted sufficient statistics, repeated to verify determinism. Intervals describe the development panel and do not alter original point gates.
uncertainty.limitations: Existing panels are development-exposed; family exchangeability, shared evolutionary histories and prediction-induced dependence limit bootstrap interpretation. No independent generalization or superiority claim follows from a point gain or interval alone.

backend_interpretation: Report HMMER-minus-builtin precision/recall/F1 point differences and paired intervals explicitly. A favorable HMMER-versus-off result alone does not establish HMMER-specific benefit if the same gain comes from the native decision policy. Profile construction, transitions, priors, scoring and significance remain bundled backend effects, not individually isolated mechanisms.
comparison: All eight endpoint columns; new unrun QfO/Three Kingdoms slots remain NA. Retained comparator vectors retain their inherited-evidence/population limitations. Functional EC/GO/FAS means are not F1.
git: Commit/push before actual readback; freeze tested reader source and retain fresh readback output/failed attempts. Do not modify any queued scientific source or original producer artifacts.
